data.name: Manzoorat
data.gender_notes: Manzoorat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Manzurah’, which means 'victorious' or 'triumphant'. This name carries deep spiritual significance in Islam, representing the triumph of righteousness over evil. The name Manzoorat carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manzoorat usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the triumph of faith and good deeds.
data.etymology: Manzoorat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manzoorat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Manzoorat
in_english.meaning: The one who is pleased with you, the one who sees you with favor
in_english.long_meaning: Manzoorat is an Arabic name that means 'the one who is pleased with you' or 'the one who sees you with favor'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-z-r' which means 'to see' or 'to look at'. In Islamic tradition, Manzoorat is associated with the concept of Allah's pleasure and favor. It is said to be the name of a person who is blessed with Allah's pleasure and favor, and who is guided by Allah's wisdom. In Sufism, Manzoorat is considered a state of spiritual growth and development, where the individual is able to see the world with the eyes of Allah's pleasure and favor.
